item.title: fix(ollama): stop response handling after abort (#125961)
item.summary: fix(ollama): stop response handling after abort (#125961) Recheck the request signal after an async response hook settles so a concurrent abort cannot reach response body handling. Related to #125802 and #125834. Co-authored-by: Onur Solmaz <2453968+osolmaz@users.noreply.github.com>
